items.text:
Showreel Sunday!

It’s that time again,  your chance to get your face seen! 

Drop your showreel link in the comments below, whether you’re an actor, voice-over artist, presenter, or creative, this is your space to shine. ✨

You never know who might be scrolling through… casting directors, agents, indie producers, someone out there could be looking for you.

✅ Remember to include your name, playing age, and Spotlight or agent details (if you’ve got them).

We want to encourage all our members to share their work, the more places you share your showreel, the more chances you’ve got of being seen. So don’t hold back,  post it proudly!  

So go on, don’t be shy. Share your showreel, show your talent, and take the spotlight.

It’s your stage, own it. 💪🎬🇬🇧

sharedPost.text: So in 2022 I was dj’ing for the gifted and talented Kurt Elling at the Jazz Cafe in London when at the end of the night an elderly hand reached over the side of the booth and tapped on it with the words “Mr DJ man - lovely tunes” I looked up and there in front of me was the legendary actor Patrick Stewart - my heart was literally in my mouth and when I got aver the shock I chatted to him for about 10 minutes about life, music, his beloved Yorkshire, and the Universe - that was a night I will not forget in a hurry - RIP Patrick you were the very definition of Everyman

🎬 SCHAUSPIELER & CREW GESUCHT: Darsteller und Helfer für Independent-Horrorfilm gesucht! 🩸

Du liebst Horrorfilme und wolltest schon immer mal bei einem echten Langfilm dabei sein? Das Drehbuch steht bereits, und wir planen einen abendfüllenden **Horrorfilm mit ca. 60 Minuten Laufzeit**!

Dafür suchen wir ein engagiertes Team, das Lust hat, dieses große Projekt gemeinsam auf die Beine zu stellen.

**WICHTIG VORAB:** Da es sich um ein reines Hobby- und Independent-Projekt handelt, gibt es **kein Geld**. Der Spaß an der Sache, das gemeinsame Kreieren, Teamgeist und die Leidenschaft für das Filmemachen stehen absolut im Vordergrund! Perfekt, um Erfahrungen zu sammeln und Material für das eigene Portfolio zu gewinnen.

👥 Wen wir suchen:

**🎭 DARSTELLER & SCHAUSPIELER (m/w/d)**
* **Alter:** 18 bis 60 Jahre
* **Aussehen:** Völlig egal! Ob dick, dünn, groß oder klein – wir suchen echte Charaktere.

🎬 **CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW**
**8 OPENINGS | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

We're looking for new actors and performers to join *The Bros Show*, an independent South London teen comedy series full of chaos, banter, unexpected situations and mockumentary-style humour.

We're currently casting **seven character roles and one background role**. If you're interested in acting and want to be part of an independent production, we'd love to hear from you!
🎭 ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Posh Bird 1**
A confident, fashionable and outspoken character with attitude, personality and plenty of banter.

**2. Posh Bird 2**
Playful, mischievous and outspoken. Someone who can bring humour and stir things up in a scene.

**3. Posh Bird 3**
A character in the Posh Birds group who needs a confident performer with natural reactions, expressive acting and good comic timing.

**4. Posh Bird 4**
A cocky, flirty, unpredictable wildcard who brings plenty of attitude and tension, particularly around Lainey. Needs confidence, humour and strong on-camera presence.

**5. Lainey**
A recurring character who is confident, cheeky, flirty, funny and unpredictable, with a softer, caring side beneath the attitude. She has a long history with Aweys and her own personality, relationships and storylines.

**6. Officer Thompson / PC Thompson**
A believable police constable who can deliver dialogue clearly, react naturally to the Bros' ridiculous behaviour and balance authority with comedy.

**7. Auntie 2**
Part of the auntie duo. We're looking for an expressive performer with personality, natural delivery and good comic timing.

**8. Episode 5 Background Performer**
A background role for Episode 5. Ideal for someone comfortable appearing on camera, following direction and helping bring the scene to life.
🎬 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
* Natural acting and believable reactions.
* Confidence and good comic timing.
* Reliability and willingness to learn lines where required.
* Ability to take direction and work as part of a team.
* Enthusiasm for an independent comedy project.

Acting experience is welcome, but we're also open to promising newcomers.
📍 LOCATION

**South or West London.**

Applicants must be able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations. Specific dates and locations will be discussed before anyone commits.
💷 PRODUCTION DETAILS
* This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.
* Travel, food and other expenses are **not guaranteed**.
* Filming dates, expectations and role details will be discussed in advance.
* Applicants under 18 must have a parent or guardian involved in the process.
📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send:
1. Your preferred name and age.
2. Your general location (South or West London).
3. Which role or roles you're interested in.
4. A recent photo.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous performance clips, if available.
6. Your general availability.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a self-tape audition with a deadline agreed in advance. If you need an extension, please contact us before the deadline.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

We're looking for people who want to get involved, work together and help bring a unique independent comedy series to life.

🎥 **THE BROS SHOW — EIGHT OPENINGS. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, send us a message to apply!

🎬 CASTING CALL — ACTOR NEEDED FOR STUDENT SHORT FILM (£50)
Hi everyone! We are looking for an actor to play George in a university short film project for London Metropolitan University.

About the project:

Cause and Effect is a short film created as part of our university course. The script is very simple and easy to follow.

ROLE: GEORGE (18/19 years old)

• Male actor

• George is Deaf and communicates with his mother through British Sign Language (BSL)

• The role is very simple — George only has one sentence in the entire film

• BSL guidance will be provided

📅 Filming: This Saturday only

⏰ 10:00am – 1:00pm

📍 London

💷 £50 expenses/compensation

This is a student production for London Metropolitan University, and it is a great opportunity to gain experience working on a short film and add the project to your portfolio/showreel.

If you are interested, please DM me with a recent photo and a little information about yourself/your acting experience.

Feel free to tag or share with anyone who might be interested! 🎥

CASTING CALL

LOOKING FOR A MALE ACTOR WHO CAN PLAY 30-40S MAN. 

Casting one role for Palm Stone, a nonunion student short film by Tafari Lewis.

A dedicated therapist keeps herself occupied with work and household routines as her clients’ stories begin to challenge her avoidance of her own grief.

SHOOT DETAILS

November 13-14 2026 • Bel Air, Maryland

Three-day production, actor only needed for two.

COMPENSATION

Unpaid. Meals, screen credit, and footage for acting reels will be provided. 

ROLE

JACK - Supporting, man, playing late thirties. Open ethnicity.

Jennifer’s husband. Warm, playful, and loves baseball, Jack brings familiar teasing and easy affection to their relationship.

Seeking natural chemistry with Jennifer. The role includes potential hugging and cuddling; no kissing or nudity. 

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your headshot, résumé, acting reel, and availability for November 13–15 through the Google Form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSds4RfIUGX6G-V-l5qk9cZuDP1EIjcq7vwU8bUENdIzPAuSYw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=100122457934176448465

Selected applicants will be invited to submit self-tape auditions.

**CASTING CALL – DAVID (LEAD ROLE) | SHORT FILM | TORONTO**

Hello everyone! HorizonDream Productions is casting David, a lead role in our upcoming short film: **Boarding Home**!

**Logline: **When a hopeful young woman arrives at a boarding home to visit a friend, her attempts to help the people living there catch the attention of a quiet, dejected mechanic who starts questioning why she's really there.

**About David:**

David is a quiet, guarded mechanic who has become withdrawn after facing difficulties in his own life. Beneath his reserved personality is someone who still cares deeply about the people around him.

The role explores frustration, vulnerability, humour, and emotional connection. We welcome emerging actors who want to gain experience, build their portfolios, and bring their own interpretation to the character!

**Casting Details:**

**Non-Union | Unpaid | Meals Provided on Set | IMDb Credit | Professional Reel Footage**

**Rehearsal:** Friday, November 6, 2026
**Filming:** Saturday, November 7, 2026
**Location:** Toronto, Ontario
**Audition Deadline:** Wednesday, November 4, at 6:00 PM EST

**Applicants must be available for both dates.**

**Interested in auditioning?**

Email your headshot, resume, and demo reel (if available) to jonosei@horizondreamproductions.ca to receive the audition materials!

Auditions consist of a short, approximately one-page scene. Phone recordings are welcome, and memorization isn't required.

If you know someone who might be interested, feel free to share this casting call!

ROLLENAUSSCHREIBUNG: Frauen und Männer 55–75 für Handy-Aufnahmen zu Hause (Online-Werbung)

Projekt: Werbevideos für FITprofil, eine App mit Band fürs Handgelenk (Berlin)

Gesucht: 3 Personen, Frau oder Mann, 55–75 Jahre, ganz normaler Typ, keine Kamera-Erfahrung nötig

Umfang: Band und App 7 Tage im Alltag nutzen, danach ca. 20 Minuten Aufnahmen mit dem eigenen Handy nach einer einfachen Anleitung. Kein Text zum Auswendiglernen: Gesagt wird nur, was für dich stimmt.

Drehort: bei dir zu Hause (Versand des Bands nach DE, AT oder CH)

Zeitraum: Auswahl bis 30.10., Versand ab 31.10., Aufnahmen bis 12.11.

Gage: 80 € nach Abnahme, dazu das Band zum Behalten und 1 Jahr FITprofil PRO

Verwendung: Online-Werbung (Social Media, Website, App Stores), 24 Monate, schriftliche Vereinbarung vorab. Gesicht und Stimme werden nicht mit KI verändert.

Bewerbung per PN: Alter, Wohnort, ein aktuelles Foto oder ein 10-Sekunden-Video, in dem du dich kurz vorstellst.

Szukamy osób do krótkiego nagrania na social media!

Poszukujemy osób do udziału w rolce promującej kabanosy/ wyroby wędliniarskie. Nagranie będzie miało formę krótkiej, swobodnej sondy – do powiedzenia będą dosłownie 1–2 zdania na temat produktu i pokazanie naturalnej, pozytywnej reakcji na jego otrzymanie.

Nie wymagamy doświadczenia przed kamerą, zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności i swobodzie wypowiedzi.

Wynagrodzenie: 80 zł za ok. 20 minut.

📍 Miejsce: Wrocław

📅 Termin: 5 listopada, w nagrania w godzinach  10:00–15:00 (do uzgodnienia)

Przed nagraniem konieczne będzie podpisanie zgody na wykorzystanie wizerunku w materiałach publikowanych w mediach społecznościowych marki.

Osoby zainteresowane prosimy o wiadomość prywatną wraz z aktualnym zdjęciem.

🎬 **SUBMISSIONS OPEN!**

Looking for new opportunities to get your film seen?

CHEYNI invites independent filmmakers to explore **free Open Calls from film curators** and submit their work for consideration.

Whether you make fiction, documentary, animation, experimental films or short films, discover opportunities to connect with curators looking for new voices and stories.

🌍 **MORE THAN A SCREENING**

Selected films can receive:
* 🎥 Digital distribution on CHEYNI
* 🎞️ Physical screenings at partner venues and cultural spaces
* 🌐 International exposure through curated film collections
* 🏆 Distribution opportunities and awards offered by curators

📢 **FREE OPEN CALLS ARE AVAILABLE**

Explore current opportunities, discover what curators are looking for and submit your film directly.

🔗 **Browse Open Calls:** [https://cheyni.io/open-calls](https://cheyni.io/open-calls)

Your next audience might be somewhere you haven't reached yet.

I'm León — fine line and micro-detail. Most of my work starts exactly like that: a screenshot someone saved months ago. This piece started as one too.

I work by appointment only — from my own private studio, and as a guest artist at studios in the Hollywood / West Hollywood / Los Feliz / Echo Park area.

Send me the screenshot and we'll look at it together — even if it's just to ask.
More of my work: @lj.ttt___

[Casting Call] Hot Singles Needed for Dating App Promo Video (Paid, SF Bay Area)
Hi everyone! We are casting for a lifestyle promo video and street interview shoot for a dating app in the SF Bay Area. We are currently looking for:
Role: Single Female & Single Male (Cast individually or paired on-site).
Age Range: 28-45 years old.
Ethnicity: White (for the single female) / Open or matching requirements.
Requirements: Athletic/fit build, attractive, high energy, outgoing, native English speakers, and comfortable with dating/flirty street interview style lines.
General Project Details:
Location: San Francisco Bay Area (Outdoor/urban spots like streets, cafes, parks, and restaurants).
Shoot Time: Late October or Early November
Shoot Duration: Approx. 10 hours.
Compensation: Paid (Competitive rate, details shared upon application).
What to Expect:
Casual, authentic lifestyle interactions, street interviews, and fun dating app promotional clips.
How to Apply:
If you are interested, please send a PM or comment below with:
Recent photos / headshots (Full-body & close-up).
A short intro (Name, age, and your location in the Bay Area).
Contact info or social media handles (Instagram/Portfolio).
Looking forward to hearing from you!

Hej, vi søger forskellige statister til vores afgangsfilm på Københavns film og fotoskole der vil blive filmet i København i uge 47!

Vi søger:

Gammelt ægtepar (60-80 år)

Mor med barnevogn (30–45 år)

Ungt kærestepar (25-30 år)

Gæster til fest (23-30 år)

Jobbet er desværre ulønnet, men vi sørger for snacks og noget at drikke! 

Mvh Valdemar Billing, Producer

Skriv til [valdemar.billing@gmail.com](mailto:valdemar.billing@gmail.com) for interesse eller mere info!

🎃 Looking for a fun Halloween plan this Friday? This event is for you!

Join Film Society Denmark for an evening of film trivia, charades and a lot of laughs at Meininger Hotel Copenhagen!

Come with friends or come solo. Everyone is placed in a mixed team, so it’s one of the easiest ways to meet fellow film lovers in Copenhagen and make friends!

What’s in store:
Film trivia: classics, blockbusters, world cinema
Movie charades: act or guess the right movie name
🏆 Prizes for the winning team, plus a special award for the best charades performance

Spots are limited, so book your ticket early. See you there! 🍿

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS
FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

CALLBACKS — BY INVITATION ONLY

Friday, November 13, 2026 | 10:00 AM

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

REHEARSALS & PERFORMANCES

Rehearsals Begin: January 10, 2027

Technical Rehearsals: April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement: April 8 – May 30, 2027

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please note: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with or a sponsor of this production.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

items.text:
Hello! My name is Shweta Walia and I am a co-producer of an upcoming short South Asian Film called “The Ideal”.
We're looking for some (Production Assistants) PAs to be featured in this film! The team is looking for those who are curious being on a professional film set, and can help on set. PAs with prior experience preferred. High Schoolers interested in film making are also encouraged to apply. 
Please see flyer for details. 

We will be shooting Nov. 12th -15th in various locations in Northern VA (Reston, Herndon, Ashburn etc.) and we will provide food as well. If interested, please email treelineproductions1204@gmail.com with the email subject: Interest as PA - NAME, or DM us @treelineproductions!

About the Film
The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite
following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while
the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to surface.

sharedPost.text:
We are now in Preliminary Casting for The Prodigal Daughter. 

Set to the Biblical parable of the Prodigal Son. Is a famous story about a father who welcomes back his rebellious younger son with joy, despite the son wasting his inheritance, while the faithful older brother remains resentful. 

This story sets the stage for a daughter (early 20's) who gets her inheritance share from her late grandmother, and she thinks she can make it on her own. 

Rather than listen to the wisdom of her parents, she is rebellious and moves into a small studio apartment and takes the false advice of those who she thinks are her friends. With the influence of her "friends" she soon squanders her inheritance, and ends up loosing her studio apartment, turns to a life of drugs and prostitution..
In a state of despair, she take a blade to slit her wrists and end her life. It is true a sheer act of redemption that she decides to return back to the family home to seek forgiveness from her parents.

A story that is gripping and shows the real struggles of many that are homeless and wanting a way home, through hope.

NOTE: ALL LEAD ROLES ARE NOW GONE. ONLY LOOKING FOR SUPPORT ACTORS. 

FILMING: BLACKPOOL AREA. APRIL 2027

Movie idea:

Title: Myrmarachne

Main areas/ Movie shoot locations: Leamington, Warwick and Willenhall Coventry. 

Main genres: Psychological horror, fantasy

Age range: 18-21

Key points: Unpaid job or travel. This is a project designed simply for fun with people to make friends with who share the same interests with film acting. 

I'm looking for people who are talented enough 😉 to take part and show a beautiful presentation of the mixture of different emotions portrayed by the characters in order to create a life-like, real story and adventure through this surreal psychological thriller with connections to supernatural, spiritual and metaphysical concepts.

Important note: The earliest the movie will most likely start being filmed is late 2027/ early 2028. This is because even though I have the plot written, i still have to finish writing other pages including multiple scripts. I think that is plenty of time for us to use and spend by getting to know each other, diving and learning about your own individual characters, learning scripts, rehearsing scenes, going over the plot and making a new friend group.

Movie description: A group of teenagers and friends begin to experience bizarre occurences within their neighborhood. During a trip in the local woods, after getting lost within a muddle of different dimensions, and after making contact with several other-worldly creatures, out of fear and panic, they get split apart. At some point, after learning that part of the supernatural is connected to heavenly love, they eventually try and get together and escape the dangers within their world and enter the "higher realms."

To apply for a role, send me: Acting CV and personal showreel (if you have these).

Please send over a 1-3 minute long self-tape of your own choice. 

Personal details: Name, height, age, city/ town, headshot.

Any questions, you can message me personally.

Further details about the plot and overall project will be released in personal groupchats and messages for people who are interested.

# **🎬 **PAID: CASTING CALL | Vancouver Short Film *Unproven*****

Hello! We are casting two male leads!

*Unproven* is a 13–14-minute narrative short about two strangers who meet in a Vancouver laundromat and gradually enter each other’s worlds over the course of one night.

The screenplay received an Honourable Mention at the 5th Hong Kong Lesbian and Gay Film Festival Short Film Screenplay Competition. The project was also selected for the 3rd International Film Creation Camp, organized by the Asian Film Awards Academy (AFAA).

****ROLES****

• **Ishaan | Male, South Asian, 20–25**

A Pakistani international student preparing for a refugee claim interview. Fluency in English and Urdu is required.

• **Ah Long | Male, Asian, 24–30**

A Hong Kong immigrant currently living and working in Vancouver. Fluency in Cantonese and good English proficiency are required.

📍 Location: Vancouver  

📅 Tentative shoot dates: Late November 2026 (3-4 days in total)  

💰 Paid role | Non-union production | Meals and screen credits provided 

Actors of all experience levels are welcome to apply. Actors must be comfortable performing intimate scenes and physical contact. No nudity or explicit content is involved.

To apply, please email *unprovenfilm@gmail.com *with a recent headshot, contact information, availability for the shoot dates, and language proficiency. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an in person audition in early November.

Please share or repost if you know someone who will be a good fit! Thank you!

🎬mentoring aktorski 
🎬nagranie wizytówek w Warszawie
🎬montaż demo aktorskiego zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów obsady 

Szczegóły w opisie i na priv :)

sharedPost.text:
Chcesz zostać aktorką/aktorem albo mieć więcej aktorskiej pracy ale nie wiesz co konkretnie zrobić? 🤔 Jeżeli tak - zapraszam na konsultacje do mnie, nagranie wizytówek i montaż demo aktorskiego! 🎬🤩 Szczegóły w opisie! 

🎥 Mentoring aktorski 

Dla kogo? 

Dla każdego kto chce pracować jako aktor/aktorka na planach zdjęciowych. Zarówno dla tych bez doświadczenia, któryórzy nie wiedzą jak zacząć i co zrobić jak i dla tych co już pierwsze kroki mają za sobą ale chcieliby mieć więcej pracy i potrzebują rady w tym zakresie 🙂 

Na czym polega? 

Spotkanie ze mną 1:1 online, trwające godzinę. Opowiesz mi jakie zlecenia aktorskie Cię interesują - czyli Twój aktorski cel i według tego dobieramy odpowiedni plan działania. Jeżeli masz materiały aktorskie - to je omówimy i powiem co warto byłoby jeszcze do nich dodać lub jak je “podrasować”. Jeżeli nie masz to dowiesz się co i jak masz zrobić żeby je mieć 🙂 Powiem o moich poleceniach agencji aktorskich, jak samodzielnie i łatwo zrobić demo, jak nagrać i co powiedzieć w wizytówkach, jak samodzielnie szukać pracy, jak się wyceniać, na co uważać. I odpowiem na wszystkie inne Twoje pytania. Po spotkaniu otrzymasz ode mnie maila z planem działania i priorytetami do wykonania + materiałami pomocniczymi dot. materiałów aktorskich. 

🎥 Coaching aktorski z wizytówki + nagranie wizytówek w studio 

Na czym polega? 

✅ Tworzę tekst do wizytówek na podstawie informacji o Twoim doświadczeniu, pasjach, zainteresowaniach, który dostajesz przed nagraniem według castingowych wytycznych, który pokaże Twoje największe atuty

✅W studio nagrań nagrywamy 3-4 wizytówki:

🎬 do filmów i seriali 
🎬 do reklam w wersji dłuższej 
🎬 do reklam w wersji krótszej 
🎬 w języku obcym 
Ewentualnie możemy dograć wizytówkę modelingową 

✅ W trakcie nagrywania zadbam o Twoje rozluźnienie, dobrą atmosferę oraz zrobimy kilka ćwiczeń które pomogą pokazać na wizytówkach Twoją energię i błysk w oku 
oraz będę czuwać nad całym procesem

✅ Wizytówki nagramy według aktualnych standardów i wymogów castingowych 

✅ Dostaniesz zmontowane wizytówki gotowe do wysłania przez WeTransfer

🎥 Demo aktorskie 

montaż demo aktorskiego + konsultacja 

Na czym polega? 

✅ otrzymasz ode mnie demo aktorskie zmontowane zgodnie z obecnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu + podczas konsultacji wspólnie dobierzemy sceny, które się w nim znajdą oraz przedstawię Ci mój pomysł na ich kolejność 

Podczas konsultacji dowiesz się również:

✅ jak pobierać materiały do demo aktorskiego 
✅ jakie są obecne wymogi i standardy wzgledem aktorskiego demo 
✅ jakie sceny wybierać i w jakiej kolejności je zmontować  
✅ jak samemu w łatwy sposób przemontować demo pod konkretny casting 

Szczegóły priv

🎥 Montaż demo aktorskiego z konsultacją 

Potrzebujesz demo aktorskiego, które pokaże Twój talent aktorski i wszechstronność a jednocześnie będzie zgodne z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu? Chcesz dowiedzieć się jak pobierać materiały i jak tworzyć takie demo samemu w przyszłości w łatwy sposób oraz jak zwiększyć swoje szanse na konkretną role? ✅ dokładnie przejrzę Twoje aktorskie materiały, wybiorę najlepsze aktorsko sceny oraz różnorodne pod względem emocji i ról

✅ zmontuję demo zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu uwzględniając również to, które sceny Ty uważasz za najlepsze 

✅ podczas konsultacji opowiem Ci o obecnych standardach montażu i doboru scen, dam dużo cennych rad abyś mogła / mógł w przyszłości montować demo samodzielnie 

✅ gotowe demo dostaniesz ode mnie maksymalnie w 2 dni od wysłania mi swoich materiałów

✅ przystępna cena 💵 szczegóły na priv 

Na zdjęciach załączam jedną z wiadomość od klienta po moim montażu 🔥💪 

Uwaga! Nie zajmuję się pobieraniem materiałów.

Cześć! Szukamy 3 osób w wieku od 17 do 23 lat, chętnych do zagrania w krótkometrażowym horrorze „WINA”

Produkcja niezależna, udział non-profit. Poszukujemy osób do trzech ról, głównej, epizodycznej (postać pojawiająca się w dwóch scenach) oraz antagonisty.

Scenariusz został napisany z myślą o postaciach męskich, ale jesteśmy otwarci na przepisanie niektórych ról, żeby dopasować je do aktorek.

Termin zdjęć: grudzień–styczeń (planowo)
Lokalizacja: okolice Trójmiasta
Czas na planie: około 3 dni zdjęciowych
Zapewniamy: wyżywienie na planie i dobrą atmosferę.

Zainteresowany/a? Napisz wiadomość prywatną!

**CASTING CALL – CHRISTMAS FAMILY COMMERCIAL**
* **Father actor:** White/Caucasian, playing age around 35
* **Mother actress:** White/Caucasian, playing age around 35
* **Daughter actress:** Playing age around 10
* **Applicants:** Individual actors and real families welcome
* **Story:** Warm, everyday family moments at Christmas
* **Shoot date:** Early December
* **Shoot Location:** Unionville, Markham
* **Commitment:** One-day shoot, 8 hours
* **Pay:** $70/hour per performer ($560 for the day)
* **To apply:** Send recent photos/headshots, relevant acting experience or a reel, and your early December availability
* **Child applications:** Must be submitted by a parent or guardian
* **Contact:** andrewt@rangerfilms.studio and avery@rangerfilms.studio

CASTING NOTICE: 

Casting actors for DOMINION, an indie psychological thriller feature set over the course of an increasingly disturbing encounter between two men. 

Paid roles, exact rate TBD.

Location: Los Angeles (likely in the Valley)

Shoot: Approximately 5-7 days, dates TBD (likely early 2027)

Non-union

EVAN

Mid-20s

Male

Attractive, personable, confident. Has a strong emotional side and tends to become invested in people who seem vulnerable or troubled. Compassionate but has a savior complex. Requires strong naturalistic acting and the ability to convey conflict without overplaying it. 

FINN

Mid-20s

Male

Thin build. Quiet, unreadable demeanor. Shy on the surface but dangerous underneath. Requires vulnerability and unpredictability through subtle expressions and understated performance. 

Please DM me with headshot, reel, resume/credits, role you're interested in.

3 April – 16 May 2027

16 May – 18 October 2027

17 November 2027 – 20 June 2028

☑️ €3,000–€3,400/month on board (depending on role)

☑️ Guest status

Please note: A 10% agency commission will be deducted from the stated salary.

• Good dancing and movement skills

• Previous cruise ship experience is MANDATORY

🚨 URGENT CASTING – MALE SINGER 🎤
🚢 German Cruise Ship | Long-Term Contract 2027–2028

KOP Entertainment Agency is urgently looking for a strong and versatile male singer with good dancing abilities to join a professional show ensemble on board a German cruise ship.

📅 CONTRACT DATES

🇩🇪 Rehearsals in Germany:

3 April – 16 May 2027

🚢 First onboard contract:

16 May – 18 October 2027

🌴 Approximately 1-month break

🚢 Second onboard contract:

17 November 2027 – 20 June 2028

💰 SALARY & BENEFITS

☑️ €3,000–€3,400/month on board (depending on role)

☑️ Paid rehearsals

☑️ Single cabin

☑️ Guest status

☑️ Opportunity to earn additional income through solo performances

Please note: A 10% agency commission will be deducted from the stated salary.

🎭 REQUIREMENTS

• Strong solo vocalist (pop, rock & musical theatre)

• Good dancing and movement skills

• Previous cruise ship experience is MANDATORY

• Availability for both contract periods

📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send your CV, headshot, vocal showreel and dance/movement video to:

📧 info@kopentertainmentagency.com

Email subject: Male Singer – Casting 2027/2028

💬 For more information, contact us on Telegram:

https://t.me/kopentertainmentagency

📢 Referrals, tags and shares are highly appreciated!

KOP Entertainment Agency

Morgen geht's los! 🎭

Am Montag, 2. November, startet unser Online-Schauspielkurs, und es sind noch 3 Plätze frei.

Sechs Wochen lang triffst du dich montags mit einer kleinen Gruppe online und arbeitest an Rollen, Texten und Szenen. Zu deinem Spiel bekommst du persönliches Feedback. Vorkenntnisse brauchst du nicht, der Kurs ist für Einsteiger und für alle, die nach einer Pause wieder spielen möchten.

▪️ Start: morgen, Montag, 2. November 2026

▪️ 6 Live-Abende, montags 18–20 Uhr

▪️ online via Google Meet, von überall aus

▪️ noch 3 Plätze frei

▪️ 279 €

Anmelden kannst du dich hier: www.schauspielwerkstatt-berlin.de/schauspielkurs

Wir freuen uns auf dich! 🤩

Astazi pot cu îndrazneala sa spun ca îs psiholog!
Nu ca am finisat cursul de psihologie,  dar si aceasta la fel conteaza,  psiholog care mult si-a transformat în Sine,  în interior datorita  cu situatiile din exterior,  datorita oamenilor pe care ne trimite Dumnezeu în calea mea, în Viata mea una din cele mai Frumoasa Poveste "Viata" 
Dragi Prieteni traiti Viata Frumoasa, dar daca uneori se primeste mai altfel pentru aceasta si exista Psihologie si Psihologi da cu litera mare,  fiindca cînd un professional vede Roada lui merita sa se numeasca Psiholog cu litera mare. 
Aveti grija de Sufletele Voaste...

ESSOGO EKOLLO : L’ART DANS TOUTES SES DIMENSIONS, AU RENDEZ-VOUS DES ENFANTS !

Artiste pluridisciplinaire venu de Yaoundé, Essogo Ekollo est échassier, clown, jongleur et cracheur de feu. Un artiste aux multiples talents, dont l’énergie et la disponibilité ont marqué les différentes éditions du Festival International Reconnection depuis son lancement en 2022.

Pour cette 5ᵉ édition, ce fidèle compagnon du FIR revient avec un spectacle spécialement conçu pour les enfants. Il prendra également part au grand carnaval du festival en tant qu’échassier, apportant sa touche spectaculaire à la parade.

Une nouvelle rencontre avec un artiste dont la fidélité et la générosité contribuent, édition après édition, à faire vivre l’esprit du FIR.

FIR édition 5: Du 12 au 15 novembre 2026 à Dschang.

Reconnection : des savoirs endogènes à la création !

#FIR5 #FestivalInternationalReconnection #EssogoEkolo #SpectaclePourEnfants #CarnavalDuFIR #ArtsDuSpectacle #Culture #Dschang

Artistic Director: Nika Shirocorad (Royal Academy of Music)

🚨 URGENT CALL FOR AUDITIONS

PROMOTING THE NEXT GENERATION OF CLASSICAL TALENT

We are seeking prominent young instrumentalists and classical/operatic singers (Ages 11–18) across York, Leeds, and Yorkshire to showcase their talent on a professional stage.
Selected youth musicians will receive a featured solo performance slot in our grand launch concert, performing alongside seasoned classical artists.

📅 THE AUDITIONS

• DATE: Sunday, 22nd November
• TIME: From 13:30 (Individual slots assigned upon registration)
• LOCATION: St.Chad's Church, YO23 1EY
• REQUIREMENTS: Two contrasting classical pieces/movements showing technical facility and musical maturity.
🎹 Accompaniment Policy for Singers: Vocalists must audition with a pianist. You are welcome to bring your own, or you can pre-book the official series accompanist for a student concession fee of £100 (covers score prep, 2 mandatory rehearsals, and the concert).

Do kolejnego listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do następujących ról:

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.„Pilczak” (39) – szczupły, wysoki, może mieć tatuaże, blizny, dłuższe włosy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

3.Paweł(42) – właściciel spalonej lakierni. Typ cwaniaka, wygadany, trochę porywczy. Wysoki, przystojny. 
Data: 11. listopada
Stawka: 1 tys. zł netto

4.Ilona (39) – żona Pawła. Skromna, przestraszona całą sytuacją. Skromnie ubrana, lekki makijaż lub brak.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 800 zł netto

5.Witek(58) – serdeczny, dobry człowiek. Zmartwiony losem konkurent. Ubrany w ubranie robocze.  
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 700 zł netto

6.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

7.Bartek (32) – pracownik w lakierni samochodowej oraz informator policji. Szczupły, lubi biegać, krótkie włosy, ubrany w sportowe ubrania.
Data: 11 i 12 listopada 
Stawka: 1400 zł netto za całość

8.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

9.Komisarz(46) – komisarz z komendy wojewódzkiej. Zajmuje się rozpracowaniem gangu kradnącego samochodu. Konkretny, zdecydowany, zależy mu na uratowaniu informatora. Wysoki, dobrze zbudowany, wysportowany, ubrany taktycznie i na bojowo – spodnie bojówki, polar z goretexu.   
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 2 tys. zł netto za całość

10.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
ŚLĄSK I OKOLICE...
Do 2 sezonu GLINIARZE ŚLĄSK, odcinek "muzyczny":) szukam:

Roman Hoffman (42)–gitarzysta bluesowy, w 1 scenie gra na gitarze. Długie włosy. Charyzmatyczny romantyk, trudny w relacjach biznesowych. Dawniej zmagał się z narkotykami. 

nagranie 3 i 6.11

stawka 600 zł za dzień

Tomasz Napiórowski „Napiór” (39)–diler narkotyków. Cwaniacki, bezczelny, pewny siebie i obyty z policją. Dobra sylwetka, wygląd człowieka z półświatka. Ubiera się wygodnie, ale modnie.

nagranie 5.11

stawka 800 zł

Krzysztof Adamski (39) –znany wokalista. Charyzmatyczny, pewny siebie, dumny. Zadbany, ubrany w stylu boho.

nagranie 3.11

stawka 600 zł, 1 scena

Zainteresowane osoby proszę o zgłoszenie na email obsadaolga@gmail.com

Zgłoszenie musi zawierać imię, nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, aktualne zdjęcie demo lub wizytówkę.

W tytule proszę wpisać wybraną postać.

1.Bocian (35) – postawny, łysy, tatuaże, agresywny, porywczy, typ gangusa  - prawo jazdy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

2.„Pilczak” (39) – szczupły, wysoki, może mieć tatuaże, blizny, dłuższe włosy
Data: 11 i 12. listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

3.Paweł(42) – właściciel spalonej lakierni. Typ cwaniaka, wygadany, trochę porywczy. Wysoki, przystojny. 
Data: 11. listopada
Stawka: 1 tys. zł netto

4.Ilona (39) – żona Pawła. Skromna, przestraszona całą sytuacją. Skromnie ubrana, lekki makijaż lub brak.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 800 zł netto

5.Witek(58) – serdeczny, dobry człowiek. Zmartwiony losem konkurent. Ubrany w ubranie robocze.  
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 700 zł netto

6.Artur (27) – pracownik lakierni samochodowej. Dobrze zbudowany, postawny, krótkie włosy. Konkretny, chętnie rozmawia z policją.
Data: 11 listopada
Stawka: 600 zł netto

7.Bartek (32) – pracownik w lakierni samochodowej oraz informator policji. Szczupły, lubi biegać, krótkie włosy, ubrany w sportowe ubrania.
Data: 11 i 12 listopada 
Stawka: 1400 zł netto za całość

8.Stróż (60) – stróż pracujący na złomowisku. Ciekawski, interesuje się wszystkim dookoła. 
Data: 12 listopada
Stawka: 400 zł netto

9.Komisarz(46) – komisarz z komendy wojewódzkiej. Zajmuje się rozpracowaniem gangu kradnącego samochodu. Konkretny, zdecydowany, zależy mu na uratowaniu informatora. Wysoki, dobrze zbudowany, wysportowany, ubrany taktycznie i na bojowo – spodnie bojówki, polar z goretexu.   
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 2 tys. zł netto za całość

10.Gangster 3 (41) – Gangster zatrzymany na złomowisku. Wysoki, chudy, tatuaże. Na początku nie chce pracować z policją, ale dociśnięty sypie wszystkich współpracowników.
Data: 12 i 13 listopada
Stawka: 1600 zł netto za całość

Chętnych aktorów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania
9. Data lub odcinek grania w pierwszym sezonie Gliniarzy Śląsk

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.title: 🎬 Statyści poszukiwani

items.text:
TELEDYSK, BIELSKO-BIAŁA 12.11/13.11

Szukamy dziewczyny do jednej z ról kobiecych w teledysku rapowym. Postać to Justyna: pretensjonalna, teatralna i przerysowana, w stylu „ciżi”. Dużo emocji i komedii. Szukamy kobiet w wieku ok. 20-35 lat z poczuciem humoru, które nie boją się przesady przed kamerą.

Na czym polega rola: Justyna „śpiewa” tekst artysty, ale nie nagrywamy Twojego głosu. Uczysz się kilku słów piosenki, a na planie grasz śpiew do nagranego głosu artysty (playback) Liczy się aktorstwo, mimika i energia, a nie to, jak śpiewasz.

Termin i miejsce: zdjęcia 12 lub 13 listopada 2026 w Bielsku-Białej. Szukamy Kobiet z Bielska-Białej i okolic, może być też z Katowic.

Stawka: 500 zł płatne po planie

Zgłoszenia wysyłaj na karinaszymocha@gmail.com, w tytule maila wpisz „TELEDYSK”. 

W zgłoszeniu prześlij: imię i nazwisko, wiek, miasto, numer telefonu, 2-3 aktualne zdjęcia (portret i cała sylwetka) oraz wizytówkę wideo (link do YouTube)

Zgłoszenia bez wizytówki wideo nie będą rozpatrywane. Odezwiemy się do wybranych osób. 😊

**Männliche Komparsen in Düsseldorf gesucht**

Hey zusammen, für die Social-Media-Accounts von SpeedDating XXL suchen wir Männer, die Lust haben, bei einem kurzen Content-Dreh mitzumachen.

Ort: Düsseldorf
Dauer: ca. 30 Minuten
Vergütung: 30 € pro Person
Zeitraum: November, den genauen Termin stimmen wir gemeinsam ab.

Dreherfahrung brauchst du nicht. Du solltest dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlen und damit einverstanden sein, dass die Aufnahmen auf unseren Social-Media-Kanälen veröffentlicht werden.

Interesse? Dann schick uns gerne eine PN mit einer kurzen Vorstellung und schreib uns, an welchen Tagen und zu welchen Uhrzeiten du im November Zeit für den Dreh hättest. Wenn du möchtest, kannst du auch ein aktuelles Foto für die Auswahl mitschicken.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht!

# **“Can’t Take You Anywhere” Student Short Comedy Film**

When an entitled teenager attends a private business event with his parents, he fails to suppress his awkward and immature nature.

Looking for ￼3 actors for a 5 minute comedy!

Roles are not paid or promised.

JOHN: Supporting role of the frat-like CEO who helps Thomas (the teenager) make a terrible first impression with a girl seemingly his age. John is overconfident, loud, and raunchy. Looking for a male actor around his 40s.

MOM: Regular mom, mid 40s, who believed her son wouldn’t make a scene and is a supportive as possible for her husband and son.

DAD: Regular dad, also mid 40s, who knew that bringing Thomas was a bad idea. Dad’s goal is to secure a deal with John, the CEO.

We are also looking for plenty of extras for the business party scene.

We will be shooting around the first three weekends of November￼ around Denver, and are fairly flexible as it should be only 1-2 sets. If you are interested or have any questions, you can reach out to me at guinnico@gmail.com or 720-255-2717, and please include resumes/headshots/acting reels!

**NOW CASTING: TikTok LIVE Host | Natural Hair & Curl Care**
Culver City, Los Angeles
Favored is looking for a host to join our TikTok LIVE shopping streams for a well-known hair care brand!
**What you’ll do:**
* Showcase natural curls and demonstrate curl-enhancing hair products
* Share hair care tips, curl routines, and product recommendations
* Engage with viewers and bring products to life in real time

**Who we’re looking for:**
* Individuals with Type 3 or Type 4 hair and natural curls
* Confident, engaging, and comfortable on camera
* Knowledgeable about natural hair care, curl routines, and styling products

**Role details:** Paid — rate based on experience
2–4 hour in-studio streams
1–2 shows per week
Potential for recurring opportunities

**Interested?** Email **livehostcasting@favored.live** and we’ll send you the submission form with next steps!

sharedPost.text:
රංගන අධ්‍යයනයේ සීමා පුළුල් කර - සිනමාවේ මායිම් බොඳ කළ අපූරු ප්‍රයත්නයක්
##################################

 සිංදු කියනකොට හෙල්ලෙන්නෙවත් නැති සමහර ගායකයො අපේ ඇතුළ තදට ම හොල්ලනව කියල අපේ රටෙන් ම අපට උදාහරණ කිහිපයක් තියනව. 
අද ප්‍රස්තුතය වුණ මේ චිත්‍රපටය The Scilence of The lambs තුළ අද්විතීය විභවයක් තියන ඒ හොලිවුඩ් නළුවා, ඇන්තනි හොප්කින්ස්(Anthony  Hopkins)  සිනමාව ඇතුළෙ නොසෙල් වී ඒක කලේ කොහොම ද කියල ටිකක් හොයල බලන්ඩයි මේ උත්සාහය.
ඒක කොයි තරම් ව්ශේෂ  ද කියල මුලින් ම පැහැදිලි කරගන්ඩ, මෙහි ප්‍රධාන නිළි භූමිකාව කරපු ජොඩී ෆෝස්ටර් (Jodie Foster) ට වුණ එක දෙයක් මතක් කරන්නං. ඒ තමයි,  පුහුණුවීම් වලදි ම  හොප්කින්ස්ගෙ නොසෙල්වෙන, නිහඬ භීෂණය මුසු බැල්මට ඇත්තටම ඇය බය වූ බව කියන සිද්ධිය..

පෙළහර පසුපස දැවැන්ත හයියක්
#########################

තෝමස් හැරිස් ගෙ නවකථාවක් ඇසුරෙන් ටෙඩ් ටැලී(Ted Tally ) තිර රචනය කරපු මේ අපූරු චිත්‍රපටය ජොනතන් ඩෙමී(Jonathan Demme) කරපු ඓතිහාසික අධ්‍යක්ෂණයක්. ඒ වගේ ම, අද්විතීය කැමරා අධ්‍යක්ෂණය තග් ෆුජිමෝටෝ(Tak Fujimoto) වන අතර,  සුප්‍රකට ක්‍රේග් මැකී (Craig Mackey)ගෙ සුවිශේෂ සංස්කරණයක්.      
        
වෙනස් තේමාවක  අභ්‍යන්තර  බර
#########################

 මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක බල අරගලය සහ මිනිස් මනසේ අඳුරු ගැඹුර (Psychological Power Struggle and the Dark  of the Human Mind) පෙන්වන මේ චිත්‍රපටය අතිශය වෙනස් එකක්.
මේක මිනිස් මනසෙහි සැඟවුණු අඳුරු පැති, බිය, අතීත කම්පන සහ බලය ගැන කතාවක්. සත්‍යය හොයා ගැනීමේ දී බුද්ධිය විතරක් නෙවෙයි, අනෙකාගේ මනස කියවීමේ හැකියාවත් ඉතා ම තීරණාත්මක බව මේකෙන් අපූරුවට පෙන්වනවා.

 ක්ලැරිස් ස්ටාර්ලින්,  FBI පුහුණුව ලබන තරුණ නිලධාරිනියක්. එම චරිතයට ජීවය දෙන්නේ ජොඩී ෆොස්ටර් (Jodie Foster).
 කාන්තාවන් පැහැරගෙන ඝාතනය කරන අනුක්‍රමික මිනීමරුවක් වන බෆලෝ බිල් අල්ලා ගැනීමේ මූලික මෙහෙයුම තමයි ඇයට භාර වෙන්නෙ. ඒකට, බන්ධනාගාරගතව ඉන්න අතිශය බුද්ධිමත් මනෝ වෛද්‍යවරයක් සහ දරුණු මිනීමරුවක් වන ආචාර්ය හැනිබල් ලෙක්ටර්ගේ (ඇන්තනි හොප්කින්ස්- Anthony Hopkins) සහාය ලබා ගන්ඩ අවශ්‍ය බව ප්‍රධානීයා ඇයට කියනව.
ඔහුව ප්‍රශ්න කරන්ඩ යන ක්ලැරිස්ට විශාල මානසික හිරිහැරයක් වෙනව. ඒ තමයි, ඔහුගේ මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක ප්‍රශ්න කිරීම් හා අමුතු මානසික ක්‍රීඩා මැද, ඇයට ඝාතකයා හොයාගන්න එක වගේ ම  තමන්ගෙ අතීතයේ වේදනාකාරී මතකයන්ගේ කරදර වලටත් මුහුණ දෙන්ඩ වෙන එක.

චරිතයක් සඳහා අප්‍රමාණ කැපවීම, පුළුල් අධ්‍යයනයේ බර සහ ප්‍රතිඵල
#################################

මට මේ ලියමනට පෙළඹවීම ඇති කරන්නේ ම, ඇන්තනි Hopkins ගෙ මේ චරිත නිරූපණයෙ තියන විශාල වෙනස. ඒකට ඔහු විශාල කාලයක් අරං, කැපවෙලා, අනවරත අධ්‍යයනයක් කර තිබෙන බව පේනවා.
දරුණු මිනීමරුවෙකු වන  ඒ චරිතය, ආචාර්ය හැනිබල් ලෙක්ටර්(Dr. Hannibal Lector) තම තිරශ්චීන බව කිසි විටෙකත් බාහිර කලබලයන්ගෙන්, ශබ්ද වලින් හෝ ශරීර චලන වලින් කරන්නෙ නැහැ. ඒ වෙනුවට ඔහුගෙ ⁣රංගන⁣ තෝරාගැනීම(Choice) වෙන්නෙ, නිශ්චල බව, ඇස් වලින් අනෙකා  මුලුමනින් ම බිම හෙළීම හා මානසික භීෂණය. සර්පයෙකු ගොදුර ඩැහැගන්නට බලා ඉන්න දරුණු සර්පයෙකුගෙ නිරීක්ෂණාත්මක නිසල බව. ඔහු සත්වෝද්‍යානයක ගොස් ඒ හැසිරීම් කාලයක් අධ්‍යයනය කළ බවත් කියා තිබෙනවා(Ethology).

මනසින් දරුණු මිනිහෙකුගෙ කෝපාවිෂ්ට ලක්ෂණ වෙනුවට, ඉතා තැන්පත් භාවනානුයෝගීව ඉන්න දැමුණු පුද්ගලයෙකු ලෙස තමයි මෙහි ඔහුගේ හැසිරීම. තම පළමු හමුවීම අධි ආරක්ෂිත හිර කුටියක ඉදිරිපිට දි සිදුවෙද්දී ම, ක්ලැරිස් ඔහු දැකල දැඩි ආතතියට පත්වෙනවා. ඒ මන්ද යත්, දෙපස සිටි සියලුම හිරකාරයින්ගෙ අශික්ෂිත, මෘග හැසිරීම් සියල්ල පසු කර ගිහින් මේ තරම් නොසෙල්වී ශාන්තව, බුද්ධිමත්ව බලා ඉන්න  මිනිසාගේ වෙනස දැඩිව අභ්‍යන්තරයට දැනීම. එයම තමයි මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මකව ඇයට දැනෙන භයානකකම. 

අනුක්‍රමික මිනීමරුවෙක්(Serieal killer) හැසිරෙන ආකාරය හිරගෙවල් වල ගොස් නිරීක්ෂණාත්මකව අධ්‍යයනය කළ හොප්කින්ස්, ඒ සියල්ලෙන් තම චරිතයට ආභාසය ගත් බවත් කියා තිබෙනවා.

විශේෂයෙන් හොප්කින්ස් 
හැනිබල් ලෙක්ටර්ගේ කටහඬේ රිද්මය සහ ස්වභාවය  ලබාගත්තේ 2001: A Space Odyssey චිත්‍රපටයේ එන HAL 9000 නැමැති කෘතිම බුද්ධි (AI) පරිගණක චරිතයෙන් බව කියැවෙනවා. ඔහුට අවශ්‍ය වුණේ කිසිදු හැඟීමක් නැති, යන්ත්‍රයක් වගේ බියකරු කටහඬක් මතුකරන්නට බව ඔහු කියනවා.

මීට අමතරව, තවත් ප්‍රසිද්ධ පුද්ගලයන් දෙදෙනෙකුගේ කටහඬවල් ද ඔහු මේ සඳහා එකතු කරගත්තේතා.
ඒ අතර ඔහු අභාසය ලබාගත්තේ, 
ටෲමන් කැපෝටි(Truman Capote) සුප්‍රසිද්ධ ඇමරිකානු ලේඛක සහ මාධ්‍යවේදියා  සතුවුණ ඉතා සුවිශේෂී, සිහින් සහ නාට්‍යමය කටහඬේ ඇති මෘදු, සිහින් සහ මෝහනීය ස්වභාවයෙන්, 
වගේ ම
කැතරින් හෙප්බර්න් (Katharine Hepburn) හොඳම නිළිය සඳහා වන ඔස්කාර් සම්මාන 4ක් දිනා ගනිමින් වාර්තාවක් තියපු සුපිරි Hollywood  නිළිය. ඇයට තියන  ඉතා තියුණු, ප්‍රතාපවත් සහ උසස් ස්වරූපයේ කටහඬ. ඇයගේ තියුණු සහ උසස් සමාජීය කටහඬේ ස්වභාවයෙන්. 

ඒ විතරක් නෙමයි, ඔහුගේ පැරණි රංගන ගුරුවරයෙකු වූ ක්‍රිස්ටෝපර් ෆෙටස් (Christopher Fettes) ගේ කටහඬ සිහිකර එය දීර්ඝව අධ්‍යයනය කළ බව කියැවෙනවා.
ෆෙටස්ට ඉතාම තියුණු, බියකරු ලෙස බුද්ධිමය වශයෙන් කෙනෙක්ව මෙල්ල කරන්ඩ පුළුවං කටහඬක් තිබුණ බව හොප්කින්ස් කියනවා.
මේ විදිහට බලනකොට නළුවෙකුගෙ සාර්ථකත්වයට කැපවීම, නිරීක්ෂණය, අධ්‍යයනය  මොන තරම්  නම් බලපානව ද කියන එක ඉතාමත් පැහැදිලියි. 

ජෝඩි ෆොස්ටර්ගේ කැපවීම (Jodie's Dedication)ත්  අපට කිසි සේත් අමතක කරන්ඩ බැහැ.
ඇය චරිතය වෙනුවෙන් Quantico හි සැබෑ FBI ඇකඩමියේ කාලයක් පුහුණුව  ලැබුවා.  ඒ වගේ ම අපරාධකරුවන්ගේ හැසිරීම් සහ FBI නිලධාරීන්ගේ ශරීර භාෂාව (body language) සමීපව අධ්‍යයනය  කළා කියල කියනවා. 
හොප්කින්ස්ගේ අසාමාන්‍ය ශරීර බස(Body language), හඬ, බැල්ම සමඟ මානසික ඒකාග්‍රතාවය තබාගන්නට ඇය වෙනම පුහුණු වූ බව ද පැවසෙනවා.

රංගනයනයේ ව්‍යාකරණයට(Acting Grammar) හිස නමා, නිර්මාණට බර තැබූ අපූරු දෙපළක්.

මේ චිත්‍රපටයේ Hannibal Lecter විදිහට Hopkinsගේ විශේෂත්වය තමයි නිශ්චලතාව තුළින් බලය ප්‍රකාශ කිරීම.
එහි දී, 
* කටහඬ (Voice): වචන පැහැදිලිව උච්චාරණය කිරීම සහ හිතාමතා පාලනය කරන කතා රිද්මය.

* බැල්ම (Eye Focus): ඇසිපිය ගැසීම පවා දැඩිව පාලනය කළ  සෘජු බැල්ම. එයින් මානසික පීඩනයක් ඇති කිරීම.

* නිශ්චලතාව (Stillness): අනවශ්‍ය ශරීර චලන අවම කර, කුඩා මුහුණේ වෙනසකට පවා විශාල අර්ථයක් ලබා දීම.

* විරාමය (Pause): වචන අතර නිහඬතාව නිසා චරිතය සහ ප්‍රේක්ෂකයා නොසන්සුන් කිරීම.

* අභ්‍යන්තර අරමුණ (Inner Objective): සංවාදයකදී තොරතුරු ලබා ගැනීම පමණක් නෙවෙයි, අනෙක් පුද්ගලයාගේ මනසට බලපෑම් කිරීම.

ඊ ළඟට, 
 Jodie Fosterගේ රංගනයෙ ව්‍යාකරණය තමයි,

*Clarice Starling විදිහට ඇය අභ්‍යන්තර බිය හා වෘත්තීය අධිෂ්ඨානය එකවර නිරූපණය කිරීම වගේම චිත්තවේග පාලනය(controling the emotions) කෘතීමව නොකිරීම.

* සවන්දීම (Active Listening): අනෙක් චරිතයේ වචනවලට පමණක් නෙමෙයි, ඒවා යට තියන තර්ජනයටත් ප්‍රතිචාර දැක්වීම.

* ප්‍රතිචාරය (Reaction): විශාල විදිහට මුහුණේ ප්‍රකාශනය වෙනුවට ඇස්, හුස්ම සහ මුහුණේ සියුම් වෙනස්කම් මඟින් හැඟීම් පෙන්වීම.(sublet emotional shift)

* අභ්‍යන්තර ගැටුම (Inner Conflict): බය තමං ව හෙල්ලුවත් රාජකාරිය ඉටු කිරීමට  නොපසුබට ව උත්සාහ කිරීම.

* ශරීර භාෂාව (Body Language): වෘත්තීය විශ්වාසය පවත්වා ගන්නවා වගේ ම, බලවත් පිරිමි චරිත ඉදිරියේ ඇති වන මහා පීඩනය සියුම්ව පෙන්වීම. ඒකෙන්, මේ දක්ෂ රහස්පරීක්ෂකවරියක් වුණත් මනුස්සයෙක් නේද, කියල ඇය රංගනයෙන් පැහැදිලිව ඔප්පු කළා.

* ක්‍රියාකාරී අරමුණ (Objective): සංවාදයකදී තම අරමුණ අත් නොහැර, ලෙක්ටර්ගෙන් අවශ්‍ය තොරතුරු ලබා ගැනීමට උත්සාහ කිරීම.

දෙදෙනාගේ රංගනයේ මූලික වෙනස විදිහටමං දකින්නෙ,
Hopkins ගෙ නිශ්චලතාව, පාලනය සහ මානසික ආධිපත්‍යය.
Foster ගෙ සවන්දීම, අභ්‍යන්තර ප්‍රතිචාර සහ පීඩනය මධ්‍යයේ අරමුණ කරා යාම.

සිනමා විශ්ලේෂණ වලට නව මානයක්    
රැසක් එක් කළ අපූරුව
##############################

මෙම චිත්‍රපටය භීෂණය පෙන්වන්නේ ලේ වැගිරීම්වලින් පමණක් නෙමෙයි, නිහඬතාව, මුහුණේ සමීප රූප, බැල්ම සහ මානසික ආතතියෙන්. ප්‍රේක්ෂකයාට සිදුවීමක් පෙන්වනවට වඩා ඒක දැනෙන්නට සලස්වන එක තමයි වැදගත් ම දේ.

මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක පක්ෂය  (Psychological Dimension) අරං බැලුවම
ක්ලැරිස්ගේ අතීත බිය සහ හැනිබල්ගේ බුද්ධිමය ආධිපත්‍යය අතර මානසික ගැටුම මෙහි ප්‍රධානයි කියල මට හිතෙනව. මෙතන හැනිබල් ප්‍රශ්න කරන්නේ තොරතුරු ලබා ගන්ඩ විතරක් නෙමෙයි.  අනෙකාගේ දුර්වලතා හඳුනාගෙන ඔහුගේ හෝ ඇයගේ මනසට බලපෑම් කරන්ඩයි.

*මේකේ දාර්ශනික පැත්ත
(Philosophical Dimension) ගත්තතත් මිනිහෙක් කියල කියන්නේ ඔහු කරන ක්‍රියාවල එකතුව පමණක් ද? බුද්ධියයි සදාචාරයයි එකම දෙයක් ද? ශිෂ්ටත්වයේ මතුපිටට යටින් ම්ලේච්ඡත්වය පවතින්ඩ බැරි ද? යන ප්‍රශ්න චිත්‍රපටය මතු කරනවා.

*දෘෂ්ටිවාදී අතින් (Ideological Dimension)ගත්තහම පිරිමින්ගේ ආධිපත්‍යය පවතින FBI වැනි ආයතනික පරිසරයක, කාන්තාවක් තම දක්ෂතාවයෙන් හා අධිෂ්ඨානයෙන් ඉදිරියට යන විදිහ විශේෂයි. ඒ සමඟම යහපත හා අයහපත අතර සීමාව පිළිබඳ ප්‍රශ්නත් රහට මතු කරනව.(ඒක චිත්‍රපටයෙ elevator එකේදි නිළධාරී පිරිම්න් රැසක් එක්ක යන මිටි ක්ලැරිස් ගෙ රූපරාමුව එහෙම තැනක් කියල මට හිතෙනවා.)

 *මෙහි සංස්කරණය (Editing) බැලුවහම Craig McKay  තොරතුරු සියල්ල එකවර හෙළි නොකර, නිවැරදි මොහොතේ විතරක් තොරතුරු ලබා දෙන්නේ, කුතුහලය පවත්වා ගනිමින්. ප්‍රතිචාර රූප (Reaction Shots), දෘෂ්ටි කෝණ මාරුකිරීම් (Point-of-View Cuts) සහ රූප අතර රිද්මය මඟින් මානසික ආතතිය වැඩි කිරීම් එමටයි. ඒ වගේමසමහර තැන් වල  අප ව ටිකක් අන්දමන්ද කරනවා. ඒකට හොඳ ම උදාහරණයක් තමයි ක්ලැරිස් බෆලෝගෙ නිවස හොයාගෙන ඇතුළුවෙද්දි, FBI පිරිමි කණ්ඩායමත් ඇතුළුවෙනව. එකම තැන වගේ.  අන්තිමට තමයි අපි දැනගන්නේ පිරිමි ගිහිං තියෙන්නේ වෙන වැරදි තැනකට කියල. ක්ලැරිස් ඉන්නේ හරි ම තැන බව අපි දැනගන්නෙ අවසානයෙදි.  හොඳින් නිරීක්ෂණය කරන කෙකෙුට පෙන්වා, එතෙක් රූප දිව ගිය මන්දගාමී බව 
අවසන් භාගයේ වේගවත් වෙනවා. ළඟ, ළඟ ඡේදනයන් (cuts) වලින් 
ප්‍රේක්ෂක අපේ ආතතිය වැඩි කරමින් යනවා.

 *මෙහි  සංගීතයෙන් (Music)
Howard Shore විශේෂ සේවයක් කරනවා. නිතර ම අඳුරු, බරපතළ හා නොසන්සුන් හැඟීමක් නිර්මාණය කරනව. සංගීතය හැඟීම් බලෙන් ප්‍රකාශ කරනවා වෙනුවට, දර්ශනයේ යටින් පවතින බිය හා අභිරහස තීව්‍ර කරන බව පැහැදිලිව පේනවා.

 *කැමරාකරණය (Cinematography) ⁣ගැන බැලුවොත්, තිර රචනයේ බරට එය සම්බන්ධ වන විදිහ අපූරුයි. කැමරා අධ්‍යක්ෂ  Tak Fujimoto, අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයා සමඟ එකතුව සමීප රූප (Close-ups) සහ චරිතයක දෘෂ්ටි කෝණය (Point of View) ඉතා ප්‍රබල විදිහට ගේනව.
ලෙක්ටර් හා ක්ලැරිස් මුහුණට මුහුණ කතා කරන විට සමීප රූප මඟින් මානසික ගැටුම ඉස්මතු කරන ගමන් ලෙක්ටර්ගේ බැල්ම හා ක්ලැරිස්ගේ ප්‍රතිචාර අතරින් බලය වෙනස් වන විදිහ පෙන්වනවා.
සිහි කළ යුතු විශේෂ ම දෙය තමයි මෙහි ප්‍රධාන චරිත දෙකේ හැම හමුවක ම සමීප රූප(Clos-up) හැම විට ම වගේ  කතා කරන්නෙ කැමරාවට. ඒ හැම සංවාදයකම තිබෙන බය, ආතතිය ප්‍රේක්ෂක අපට දැනෙන්ට තමයි එය අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයත් කැමරා අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයත් උවමනාවෙන් ම කරල තියෙන්නේ..ඒක සිනමා ඉතිහාසයට අලුත් නැතත් මෙතනදි දගින්  දිගට ම එය කර හතරවෙනි බිත්තිය(Fourth wall) බිඳ තබමින්ම, බලන අපට විවෘතව ගමන් කිරීම අති විශේෂයි.

 අවසාන අඳුරු දර්ශනවල කැමරා දෘෂ්ටි කෝණය මඟින් ප්‍රේක්ෂකයාවත් චරිතයේ බය ම අත්විඳින තත්ත්වයට පත් කරන එක විශිෂ්ටයි. කිව යුතු වැදගත් ම දේ තමයි, කැමරාකරණය තිර රචනයේ තියෙන මානසික තොරතුරු ඉතා සාර්ථකව දෘශ්‍ය අත්දැකීමක් බවට පත් කරන්ඩ කැමරා අධ්‍යක්ෂ වෙහෙසිලා තියන බව.

මඟමැර යා නොහැකි ම අංශය ලෙස මේ නිර්මාණයේ තිර රචනය (Screenplay) Ted Tally විසින් Thomas Harrisගේ නවකතාව සිනමාවට අනුවර්තනය කරන විදිහ ගැන කතා කළ යුතුමයි. මෙහි විමර්ශනය, ක්ලැරිස්ගේ පෞද්ගලික අතීතය සහ ලෙක්ටර් සමඟ ඇති මානසික ක්‍රීඩාව(psychological game) එකිනෙක සම්බන්ධ කරන විදිහ ලේසි පාසු නෑහැ. මේක දෙබස් වලින් කරන තොරතුරු හුවමාරුවක් විතරක් නෙමෙයි, මහා  බල අරගලයක් බවට පත් කරන්ඩ තිර රචනය කළ සේවය සුළුපටු නැහැ. 

චිත්‍රපටය අවසානයේ හදවතේ දෝංකාර දෙන ප්‍රශ්නයක් හැනිබල් විසින් ක්ලැරිස්ගෙන් අහනු ලබනවා. ඒ තමයි  

"බැටළු පැටවුන්ගේ කෑගැසීම නැවතිලා ද?"
මේ ප්‍රශ්නය එසේ මෙසේ එකක් නෙමෙයි, 
"බාහිර තර්ජනයක් පරාජය කිරීමෙන් අභ්‍යන්තර කම්පනයෙන් නිදහස් විය හැකි ද? මානසික සුවය යනු කුමක් ද?" මේ ප්‍රශ්නත් යට කී ප්‍රශ්නය යට තවරල තියෙනව කියල හිතෙනවා. 
කෙටියෙන් ම ඒක පැහැදිලි කරොත්, 

කුඩා කල ක්ලැරිස් ට සිද්ධ වුණ අති සංවේදී සිද්ධියක මතක නැවත නැවත ඇයව රිද්දන බව දැනගන්නා ආචාර්ය හැනිබල් එය අති බිහිසුණු ලෙස අවුස්සනවා. එහි, මැරෙන බැටළු පැටවුන් සහ උං කෑගහන සද්දෙ අදත් ඇහෙමින් ඇයව අදත් කම්පනයට පත් කරනවා. 
ඒ ශබ්දය නවත්තන්නට නං ඇයට කුඩා කළ බේරගන්නට බැරිවුණ ජීවිතය වෙනුවට මෙවර බෆලෝ බිල් නම් මනීමරුවා මරන්නට යන තරුණිය බේරාගත යුතුමයි කියල  ඇගෙ මනස කියනවා. ඇය එය අප්‍රතිහත ධෛර්යයයෙන් කරනවා. ඇය දිනනවා. 
නමුත් මිනීමරු හැනිබල් අප්‍රමාණ රැකවල් මැද වුවත් ආරක්ෂකයින් කීතු කර මස් කා පැන යනවා. 
ඔහු ඈත පෙදෙසකට ගොස් ක්ලැරිස්ට ගන්නා දුරකථන⁣ ඇමතුමෙන් අහන දේ තමයි  ඒ.  එනම්, බැටළුවො කෑ ගහන එක කැවතුණා ද?.. 
අපව අතිශය කම්පනය කරමින් චිත්‍රපටය ඉවර වෙනවා. හැනිබල් ලෙක්ටර් බැටළුවෝ මරහඬින් කෑගහන ශබ්ද තව කොතෙක් නං ඇති කරයි ද කියල අපිට හිතන්ඩ දීලා තමයි අවසානය සනිටුහන් වෙන්නේ.

විශේෂ :- 
1. මෙහි රූගත කිරීම් අතරතුර කිසිඳු වෙලාවක හොප්කින්ස් සහ ජොඩී මුහුණට මුහුණ හමු වී කතාබහ කලේ නැහැලු. 

2. දෙදෙනාගේ  හැම දර්ශනයකම පාහේ සමීපරූප එක් දිනක් පුරා එක් කෙනෙකුගේ බැගින් වෙන වෙන ම පමණක්කාලයක් පුරා රූගත කළ විශේෂ චිත්‍රපටයක් මේක.

3. පැය දෙකක් දිග මේ චිත්‍රපටයෙ අති  ⁣සම්මානනීය මේ රංගනය කරන ඇන්තනි හොප්කින්ස් රඟපාන්නෙ විනාඩි 16 යි.

4. විනාඩි 16 වුණත් හොලිවුඩයේ සුපිරි නළු ඇන්තනි හොප්කින්ස් මේ චිත්‍රපටයේ පිටපත  ආසන්න වශයෙන් 250  වරක් කියෙව්වා කියල ඔහු කියනව. පිටපතේ හැම කොමාවක් පවා ඔහු හොඳින් දැන සිටි බව කියවෙනවා. ඒ අනුව රඟපාන්නට යද්දි  දෙබස් මතක් කර කර දඟළනු වෙනුවට, ආනකාගෙ දෙබස් වලට කන් දෙන දියුණු රංගන ක්‍රමය වගේ ම, රංගන පරිශ්‍රයේ  සියලු අංග ගැන 100%ක් අවධානයෙන් ඉන්නට හැකි වූ බව ඔහු කියනවා.

-සුරංග ලක්මාල් සෙනෙවිරත්න

English  translation 👇

# An Extraordinary Attempt That Expanded the Boundaries of Acting Studies and Blurred the Boundaries of Cinema

Some singers hardly move when they sing, yet they manage to move us deeply. We have several examples of this from our own country.

With regard to today's subject, The Silence of the Lambs, I want to explore how the extraordinarily talented Hollywood actor Anthony Hopkins achieved something remarkable through stillness in cinema.

To understand just how exceptional this was, let me recall something that happened to Jodie Foster, who played the leading female role. It is said that even during rehearsals, she was genuinely frightened by Hopkins's motionless gaze, which carried an unmistakable sense of silent terror.

## The Immense Strength Behind the Performance

Based on a novel by Thomas Harris, this remarkable film was written for the screen by Ted Tally and directed by Jonathan Demme in what became a landmark achievement in cinema. The outstanding cinematography was by Tak Fujimoto, while the film featured the distinctive editing of the renowned Craig McKay.

## The Inner Weight of an Unconventional Theme

This is an exceptionally different film, exploring a psychological power struggle and the dark depths of the human mind.

It is a story about the hidden darkness within the human mind, fear, past traumas and power. It beautifully demonstrates that discovering the truth requires not only intelligence but also the ability to read another person's mind.

Clarice Starling is a young trainee FBI agent, brought to life by Jodie Foster.

She is assigned the primary mission of capturing Buffalo Bill, a serial killer who abducts and murders women. Her superior tells her that she needs the assistance of Dr. Hannibal Lecter, an extraordinarily intelligent psychiatrist and a brutal murderer who is imprisoned. The character is portrayed by Anthony Hopkins.

Clarice faces enormous psychological pressure when she goes to question him. Amid his psychological interrogations and unusual mind games, she must not only find the killer but also confront the painful memories of her own past.

## Extraordinary Dedication to a Character: The Weight and Rewards of Extensive Study

What inspired me to write this article, above all, is the remarkable difference in Anthony Hopkins's portrayal of this character. It is evident that he devoted considerable time, commitment and continuous study to developing the role.

The character of Dr. Hannibal Lecter, a brutal murderer, never expresses his savagery through outward agitation, loud noises or excessive body movements. Instead, his acting choice is stillness, completely overpowering another person through his eyes, and creating psychological terror.

It is the observant stillness of a deadly snake waiting to strike its prey. Hopkins reportedly spent considerable time observing and studying such behaviour at a zoo (Ethology).

Rather than displaying the outward signs of an enraged, mentally disturbed man, he behaves like an extremely composed, almost meditative individual.

During their first encounter, which takes place in front of a high-security prison cell, Clarice becomes deeply tense upon seeing him. Why? Because after passing through the crude and beastly behaviour of all the other prisoners on either side, she encounters a man who is sitting there, completely motionless, calm and intelligent.

The contrast affects her profoundly. That very difference is what makes him psychologically terrifying to her.

Hopkins has also spoken about visiting prisons and carefully observing the behaviour of serial killers, drawing inspiration from those observations for his character.

### The creation of Hannibal Lecter's voice

It is said that Hopkins developed the rhythm and nature of Hannibal Lecter's voice partly from the artificial intelligence computer character HAL 9000 in 2001: A Space Odyssey.

He reportedly wanted to create a frightening, machine-like voice that conveyed an absence of emotion.

In addition, he incorporated the vocal characteristics of two other famous personalities.

One was Truman Capote, the renowned American writer and journalist. Hopkins drew inspiration from Capote's distinctive, delicate and theatrical voice, particularly its soft, refined and hypnotic quality.

The other was Katharine Hepburn, the legendary Hollywood actress who holds the record of winning four Academy Awards for Best Actress. Hopkins drew inspiration from her exceptionally sharp, commanding and elevated vocal quality, including the distinctive tone of her sophisticated social manner.

That is not all. He also recalled and extensively studied the voice of one of his former acting teachers, Christopher Fettes.

Hopkins has said that Fettes possessed an exceptionally sharp voice, capable of intellectually intimidating and controlling another person in an almost frightening way.

Looking at all this, it becomes abundantly clear how much dedication, observation and study contribute to an actor's success.

### Jodie Foster's Dedication

We must never forget Jodie Foster's dedication to her character either.

She underwent training for a period at the actual FBI Academy in Quantico. She also reportedly studied the behaviour of criminals and the body language of FBI officers closely.

It is also said that she undertook separate preparation to maintain her psychological concentration while responding to Hopkins's extraordinary body language, voice and gaze.

## Two Extraordinary Actors Who Respected the Grammar of Acting and Prioritised the Art of Creation

The most distinctive feature of Hopkins's portrayal of Hannibal Lecter is his ability to communicate power through stillness.

His performance is built on several elements:

\- Voice: Clear articulation and a deliberately controlled rhythm of speech.

\- Eye Focus: A direct gaze, with even blinking carefully controlled, creating psychological pressure.

\- Stillness: Minimising unnecessary body movements and giving enormous meaning to even the smallest facial changes.

\- Pause: The silence between words makes both the character and the audience uneasy.

\- Inner Objective: During a conversation, his purpose is not merely to obtain information but to influence and manipulate the other person's mind.

Next, let us consider the grammar of Jodie Foster's performance.

\- Emotional Control: As Clarice Starling, she portrays both inner fear and professional determination without making emotional control appear artificial.

\- Active Listening: She responds not merely to the words spoken by the other character but also to the underlying threat behind those words.

\- Reaction: Instead of relying on exaggerated facial expressions, she communicates emotions through her eyes, breathing and subtle facial changes (subtle emotional shifts).

\- Inner Conflict: Although fear shakes her internally, she continues her determined effort to fulfil her professional duty.

\- Body Language: She maintains professional confidence while subtly revealing the enormous pressure she experiences in the presence of powerful male characters. Through this performance, she convincingly proves that even a highly talented investigator is, after all, a human being.

\- Objective: Throughout conversations, she never abandons her objective and continues trying to obtain the information she needs from Lecter.

The fundamental difference I see between their performances is this:

Hopkins: Stillness, control and psychological dominance.

Foster: Listening, internal reactions and pursuing an objective under pressure.

## An Extraordinary Film That Added Many New Dimensions to Cinematic Analysis

This film creates horror not merely through bloodshed but through silence, facial close-ups, gazes and psychological tension.

The most important thing is that, rather than simply showing the audience what is happening, it makes them feel what is happening.

### The Psychological Dimension

I believe the central element here is the psychological conflict between Clarice's past fears and Hannibal's intellectual dominance.

Hannibal does not question people merely to obtain information. He identifies their weaknesses and attempts to influence and manipulate their minds.

### The Philosophical Dimension

From a philosophical perspective, the film raises several profound questions:

- Is a human being defined merely by the sum of his or her actions?
- Are intelligence and morality the same thing?
- Can savagery exist beneath the surface of civilisation?

These are some of the questions the film brings to the surface.

### The Ideological Dimension

From an ideological perspective, it is particularly interesting to see a woman advancing through her talent and determination within an institutional environment such as the FBI, where male dominance prevails.

At the same time, the film subtly raises questions about the boundaries between good and evil.

### Editing

Looking at the editing, Craig McKay performs an important task by withholding information rather than revealing everything at once, providing it only at precisely the right moments to sustain suspense.

The use of reaction shots, point-of-view cuts and the rhythm between shots significantly intensifies psychological tension.

For an attentive viewer, it becomes evident that the relatively slow rhythm of the images gradually accelerates towards the final part of the film.

Through increasingly rapid cuts, the tension experienced by us, the audience, continues to build.

### Music

Howard Shore makes a remarkable contribution through the music.

It consistently creates a dark, heavy and unsettling atmosphere.

Rather than forcibly expressing emotions, the music clearly intensifies the underlying fear and mystery within each scene.

### Cinematography

The cinematography is remarkable in the way it complements the weight of the screenplay.

Cinematographer Tak Fujimoto, working together with the director, makes powerful use of close-ups and point-of-view shots.

When Lecter and Clarice speak face to face, close-ups highlight their psychological conflict while revealing the shifting balance of power through Lecter's gaze and Clarice's reactions.

One particularly important detail worth remembering is that, in almost every encounter between the two main characters, their close-ups seem to speak directly to the camera.

The director and cinematographer have deliberately employed this technique to make the audience feel the fear and tension present in every conversation.

Although this technique itself is not new in cinema history, its consistent use throughout the film, while effectively breaking the fourth wall, is particularly remarkable.

In the final dark sequences, the camera's point of view brilliantly places the audience in a position where they too experience the character's fear.

Most importantly, the cinematographer has worked exceptionally hard to transform the psychological information contained in the screenplay into a powerful visual experience.

### Screenplay

As one of the most indispensable aspects of this creation, the screenplay deserves particular attention.

Ted Tally's adaptation of Thomas Harris's novel for cinema is truly worth discussing.

The way the screenplay connects the investigation, Clarice's personal past and the psychological games she plays with Lecter is no easy achievement.

The screenplay does not merely facilitate an exchange of information through dialogue. Its contribution in transforming these conversations into an enormous struggle for power is far from insignificant.

## The Question That Echoes in the Heart After the Film Ends

Towards the end of the film, Hannibal asks Clarice a question that continues to echo in our minds:

"Have the lambs stopped screaming?"

This is not simply an ordinary question.

Beneath it lie much deeper questions:

Can defeating an external threat free someone from internal trauma?

What exactly is psychological healing?

I believe these questions are embedded within that one haunting question.

To explain this briefly:

Hannibal discovers that Clarice has been repeatedly tormented by the memory of an extremely traumatic incident from her childhood. He deliberately and brutally brings those memories to the surface.

The memory of dying lambs and their screams continues to haunt her even today, leaving her psychologically disturbed.

For those screams to stop, she must this time save the young woman who is about to be murdered by Buffalo Bill, rather than remain helpless as she was when she was unable to save a life during her childhood.

She accomplishes this with extraordinary determination and courage. She wins.

However, the murderous Hannibal escapes despite being held under immense security. He kills the guards brutally, tears them apart and escapes.

After reaching a distant location, he makes a telephone call to Clarice.

And that is when he asks her the question:

Have the lambs stopped screaming?

The film ends by leaving us deeply disturbed, making us wonder how many more times Hannibal Lecter will cause those lambs to scream in agony.

## Special Facts

1\. It is said that during the filming of this movie, Hopkins and Jodie never met face to face to have a conversation at any point.

2\. This is a particularly unusual film in which almost all the close-up shots involving the two actors were filmed separately, with each actor's shots being filmed on different days.

3\. Although the film runs for approximately two hours, Anthony Hopkins, whose performance is one of its most celebrated achievements, appears on screen for only 16 minutes.

4\. Despite appearing for just 16 minutes, the legendary Hollywood actor Anthony Hopkins has said that he read the screenplay approximately 250 times.

## Finally

If someone is thinking of becoming an actor, this extraordinary creation repeatedly reminds us just how many times more effort, dedication and preparation are required than we might initially imagine.

That, to me, is one of the most remarkable achievements of The Silence of the Lambs.

— Suranga Lakmal Senevirathne

CASTING CALL

LOOKING FOR A MALE ACTOR WHO CAN PLAY 30-40S MAN. 

Casting one role for Palm Stone, a nonunion student short film by Tafari Lewis.

A dedicated therapist keeps herself occupied with work and household routines as her clients’ stories begin to challenge her avoidance of her own grief.

SHOOT DETAILS

November 13-14 2026 • Bel Air, Maryland

Three-day production, actor only needed for two.

COMPENSATION

Unpaid. Meals, screen credit, and footage for acting reels will be provided. 

ROLE

JACK - Supporting, man, playing late thirties. Open ethnicity.

Jennifer’s husband. Warm, playful, and loves baseball, Jack brings familiar teasing and easy affection to their relationship.

Seeking natural chemistry with Jennifer. The role includes potential hugging and cuddling; no kissing or nudity. 

HOW TO APPLY

Submit your headshot, résumé, acting reel, and availability for November 13–15 through the Google Form:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSds4RfIUGX6G-V-l5qk9cZuDP1EIjcq7vwU8bUENdIzPAuSYw/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=100122457934176448465

Selected applicants will be invited to submit self-tape auditions.

OFFICIAL SELECTION - INTERNATIONAL TAGORE FILM AWARDS 2026 (Season 5) 

Please to announce that Gallimaufry
has been part of the International Tagore Film Awards lineup! 

The International Tagore Film Awards (ITFA) is a global independent film festival based in Kolkata, India, with screenings and events held in Bolpur (Shantiniketan). Inspired by the artistic legacy of Rabindranath Tagore, the festival celebrates independent cinema, storytelling, and culture from around the world.

The film was one of fifty selected from thousands of other movies. 

FESTIVAL DATE: 
30.10.26 

AUDITORIUM: 
Rathindra Mancha, Jorasanko Thakurbari, Kolkata, West Bengal, India

“From remarkable stories to outstanding filmmaking, these selected films represent creativity, passion, and excellence from around the world. Being officially selected is more than an achievement-it’s an invitation to join an international celebration of cinema and become part of a distinguished community of filmmakers. Your journey continues toward the festival’s highest honours.” - ITFA 2026

Many thanks to this news and well done to all the other selected films!!!

#filmfestival #movie #internationalfilmfestival #cinema #actor

🎭 CASTING CALL — MALE LEAD | SHEFFIELD | 2027 👑 (Please Share!)
We’re casting for the MAIN MALE LEAD in an exciting new stage production premiering at Crookes Social Club, Sheffield, to an audience of 250 people.

Blending acting, dance and immersive theatre, this dark-comedy-drag production explores heartbreak, transformation and love through sharp wit, unforgettable characters and expert storytelling.

We’re looking for a male performer who will be 18 years old by November 2026 to bring Jacques to life.

🎬 

• A confident actor with strong characterisation

• Someone open-minded and willing to explore movement & dance

• No dance experience is required, although it is preferred

• Comfortable performing kissing/intimate scenes with another male performer

• A performer who can embrace comedy, drama, vulnerability and theatricality

• Someone reliable, enthusiastic and excited to be part of a brand-new production

📅 

Rehearsals will take place every two weeks starting November 2026 until January 2027.

💰 

This is a paid performance role, with the fee negotiable.

We are also happy to help towards travel costs, distance dependent. 🚗🚆

📍 Crookes Social Club, Sheffield

🎭 Premiere: 2027

If you think you could be our Jacques, we’d love to hear from you!

📲 For more details, check out @conniedomofficial on Instagram.

PLEASE FILL OUT THE BELOW FORM TO REGISTER INTEREST!

Come and be part of something bold, camp, dark, hilarious and completely unforgettable. 👑🖤

Project Breakdown

Breakdown Title: Fireweed

Project type:  Student film

School: University Of British Columbia

Union Status: Non Union

Rate of Pay: Unpaid - Meal and credit.

Casting Director: Zev Lemke

Callback date: November 9th

Shooting Date: Dec 4-6

Project Location: Vancouver, BC

LOGLINE:

A jaded and lonely art student is met with resistance in the form of a rule-following family friend when he refuses to obey the wishes of his Mother and return home to his small town for reading week, following a devastating wildfire.

Reach out if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you and we look forward to seeing your self tapes!

-Zev

**PAID - CASTING CALL**

**Union & non-union**

**Project:** Teaser for a web series on YouTube. Subject matter is inspired by a popular post- apocalyptic book with the aim to attract existing fan interest.

**Role: **Dr. Kwang Jingshu. Man of Chinese heritage. Age 40 - 70. Must have (or the ability to do) a convincing subtle Chinese accent when speaking English.

**Synopsis of scene: **It’s is about a doctor who makes a horrifying discovery in the countryside at night that will change the face of the entire world.

**Details:** 5pm to 9pm in Vancouver on Nov 8th. The work day will include a 2 hour shoot, then recording a voice-over narration.

**Compensation**: $150

Please send a resume, reel and IMDB link to **azwartouw@googlemail.com** and I will get back to you with audition materials.

Please confirm in submissions that you're available at the date of shoot and location indicated.

**About the filmmaker:**

Anthony Zwartouw is a Vancouver-based filmmaker whose multi-award-winning short films, NECTAR and PATTER, have featured at a wide range of film festivals. He recently produced his first feature JAMES. Anthony has a range of feature and TV projects in development, spanning horror, comedy, and sci-fi fantasy—one of which he has been in talks with Disney.

Links

[[[https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2261268/](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2261268/)](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2261268/)](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2261268/)

[[[https://www.youtube.com/@DamcoveFilms](https://www.youtube.com/@DamcoveFilms)](https://www.youtube.com/@DamcoveFilms)](https://www.youtube.com/@DamcoveFilms)

@damcovefilms

**STAND-IN / EXTRAS / WARSAW / CHILDREN & TEENAGERS**

We're looking for stand-ins / extras aged **1 to 17** for a movie project - no experience required, you will be asked to do very simple tasks like "opening fridge", "sitting on couch" or "turning on TV".

We are looking for kids and teenagers of the following ethnic backgrounds / appearances:
* African
* Hispanic
* Asian
* Indian

**Where:** Warsaw, Ciechanowska street.
**When:** One day between October 29th and November 6th. The shoot will take approximately 1.5 hours.
**Rate:** PLN 500, paid via BLIK. **If you come from another city, we can cover some travel expanses.**

If you are interested, please email **atlanta.int.casting@gmail.com** with the following information:
* full name
* age
* contact phone number
* current photos

You can check our agency here: www.atlantafilms.pl

sharedPost.text:
🎃👻 THE WAIT IS OVER! RUGRATS HALLOWEEN 2026! 💜🧡

I know y’all have been waiting on these pictures, and trust me, I haven’t forgotten! Between moving into our new home, getting settled, and putting together my own Poison Ivy look 🌿💚, things have been a little hectic!

This year wasn’t as much as I’m used to doing, but sometimes life happens, and you have to make the best of what you have. The important thing is that the babies had fun, made memories, and got to enjoy their Halloween! 🥹❤️

Angelica & Chuckie understood the assignment! 😂💜🧡

A little late, but better late than never! Thank you for your patience!

Happy Halloween from our little Rugrats! 🎃👻🕷️

#Halloween2026 #RugratsHalloween #AngelicaAndChuckie #PoisonIvy #HalloweenMemories #TheWaitIsOver

Paid work

Height, weight, suit/chest, waist, and shoe size

IMDb link or acting/reenactment experience, if any

Ranks are filling fast. Apply today!

3 Rats Entertainment LLC
