🎬 **CASTING CALL — THE BROS SHOW**
**8 OPENINGS | SOUTH OR WEST LONDON**

We're looking for new actors and performers to join *The Bros Show*, an independent South London teen comedy series full of chaos, banter, unexpected situations and mockumentary-style humour.

We're currently casting **seven character roles and one background role**. If you're interested in acting and want to be part of an independent production, we'd love to hear from you!
🎭 ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Posh Bird 1**
A confident, fashionable and outspoken character with attitude, personality and plenty of banter.

**2. Posh Bird 2**
Playful, mischievous and outspoken. Someone who can bring humour and stir things up in a scene.

**3. Posh Bird 3**
A character in the Posh Birds group who needs a confident performer with natural reactions, expressive acting and good comic timing.

**4. Posh Bird 4**
A cocky, flirty, unpredictable wildcard who brings plenty of attitude and tension, particularly around Lainey. Needs confidence, humour and strong on-camera presence.

**5. Lainey**
A recurring character who is confident, cheeky, flirty, funny and unpredictable, with a softer, caring side beneath the attitude. She has a long history with Aweys and her own personality, relationships and storylines.

**6. Officer Thompson / PC Thompson**
A believable police constable who can deliver dialogue clearly, react naturally to the Bros' ridiculous behaviour and balance authority with comedy.

**7. Auntie 2**
Part of the auntie duo. We're looking for an expressive performer with personality, natural delivery and good comic timing.

**8. Episode 5 Background Performer**
A background role for Episode 5. Ideal for someone comfortable appearing on camera, following direction and helping bring the scene to life.
🎬 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
* Natural acting and believable reactions.
* Confidence and good comic timing.
* Reliability and willingness to learn lines where required.
* Ability to take direction and work as part of a team.
* Enthusiasm for an independent comedy project.

Acting experience is welcome, but we're also open to promising newcomers.
📍 LOCATION

**South or West London.**

Applicants must be able to travel to agreed filming and rehearsal locations. Specific dates and locations will be discussed before anyone commits.
💷 PRODUCTION DETAILS
* This is currently an **unpaid independent production**.
* Travel, food and other expenses are **not guaranteed**.
* Filming dates, expectations and role details will be discussed in advance.
* Applicants under 18 must have a parent or guardian involved in the process.
📩 HOW TO APPLY

Please send:
1. Your preferred name and age.
2. Your general location (South or West London).
3. Which role or roles you're interested in.
4. A recent photo.
5. Any acting experience, showreel or previous performance clips, if available.
6. Your general availability.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to submit a self-tape audition with a deadline agreed in advance. If you need an extension, please contact us before the deadline.

Please don't send your full home address or other sensitive personal information.

We're looking for people who want to get involved, work together and help bring a unique independent comedy series to life.

🎥 **THE BROS SHOW — EIGHT OPENINGS. ONE CHAOTIC UNIVERSE.**

If you're interested, send us a message to apply!

🎬 NASHVILLE, TN — EXTRAS / BACKGROUND ACTORS WANTED!
We’re looking for background actors (extras) for a student short film shooting on Saturday, November 14th in Nashville!

SCENE: A quick, busy newsroom/office scene. We’re looking for people to help bring a bustling office environment to life!

SHOOT DETAILS:

* Date: Saturday, November 14th

* Compensation: Unpaid (student film)

* Credit: Film credit provided

* Crafty: Snacks and refreshments provided on set

* Time: Very short scene. Exact call times will be sent to interested participants shortly.

REQUIREMENTS:

* Must be 21 years of age or older

* Must be able to provide a headshot

INTERESTED?

Email Producer/Director Noah Berry at noah.i.c.berry@gmail.com expressing your interest.

A Google Form will be sent to those who reach out to confirm participation and collect additional information.

We appreciate the support and look forward to having you on set! 🎥

'𝘼𝙣𝙮𝙤𝙣𝙚 𝙬𝙝𝙤 𝙞𝙨 𝙨𝙚𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙪𝙨 𝙖𝙗𝙤𝙪𝙩 𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙖𝙩𝙧𝙚 𝙥𝙚𝙧𝙛𝙤𝙧𝙢𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚 𝙢𝙪𝙨𝙩 𝙩𝙖𝙠𝙚 𝙖 𝙘𝙡𝙖𝙨𝙨 𝙬𝙞𝙩𝙝 𝙙𝙚 𝘾𝙖𝙨𝙩𝙧𝙤. 𝘼𝙨 𝙖 𝙩𝙚𝙖𝙘𝙝𝙚𝙧, 𝙙𝙚 𝘾𝙖𝙨𝙩𝙧𝙤 𝙪𝙥𝙝𝙤𝙡𝙙𝙨 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝙧𝙞𝙜𝙤𝙪𝙧 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙛𝙤𝙧𝙬𝙖𝙧𝙙 𝙚𝙣𝙚𝙧𝙜𝙮 𝙣𝙚𝙚𝙙𝙚𝙙 𝙩𝙤 𝙙𝙤 𝙨𝙪𝙘𝙝 𝙬𝙤𝙧𝙠, 𝙗𝙪𝙩 𝙘𝙤𝙢𝙥𝙡𝙚𝙢𝙚𝙣𝙩𝙨 𝙩𝙝𝙖𝙩 𝙧𝙞𝙜𝙤𝙪𝙧 𝙬𝙞𝙩𝙝 𝙩𝙧𝙪𝙚 𝙘𝙤𝙢𝙥𝙖𝙨𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣, 𝙣𝙖𝙞𝙫𝙚𝙩𝙮, & 𝙖𝙘𝙘𝙚𝙥𝙩𝙖𝙣𝙘𝙚."(𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘬𝘴𝘩𝘰𝘱 𝘱𝘢𝘳𝘵𝘪𝘤𝘪𝘱𝘢𝘯𝘵)

'𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗧𝗼 𝗕𝗲 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗻 𝗠𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝗢𝗳 𝗔 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗽𝗶𝗱' | 𝟭𝟴𝘁𝗵 𝘁𝗼 𝟮𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗝𝗮𝗻𝘂𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟳

Six days of advanced exercises and improvisations to sharpen your skills and audience responsiveness, suitable for those who want to improve their technical skills and performance craft. This workshop gives you techniques to try out immediately in structured improvisation scenarios, so you can experience how they work.

Working together, the group acts like a diverse audience, providing support and feedback as you practice these techniques.

You can take the opportunity during the week to share and receive feedback on aspects of your own act in development. In addition, all participants will be part of an end-of-workshop showing developed from the collective workshop process.

𝗘𝗻𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗻𝗼𝘄 𝗼𝗽𝗲𝗻! Limited 𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗹𝘆 𝗯𝗶𝗿𝗱 𝗱𝗶𝘀𝗰𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝘃𝗮𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲– when they’re gone, they’re gone!

For an application form & more info, please email: 𝘄𝗵𝘆𝗻𝗼𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗲@𝗮𝗼𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

Full details on all workshops on The Why Not Winter Clown School 2027: [https://thewhynotinstitute.com/when-are-the-courses/](https://thewhynotinstitute.com/when-are-the-courses/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETEwdE1KWU9FSnNMUmQ2N2prc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABH0gH2TH-q8ytQHH8FDktdBOu0ylwCpL2mHdXaxHJwIVtuUGWnU0LheZEkCop_aem_6MXY8PQGrdy2vwRoqtZjTw)

Get in touch - we’ll love to hear from you!

If you want to see some of Angela de Castro’s performing work, have a look at this: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=imgqt54HwA8](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=imgqt54HwA8&fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETEwdE1KWU9FSnNMUmQ2N2prc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABH-4L1CteF_thK1Dwxp4W9EGRTPCvV59z4akf_13FYyN2gVboy4XaTFSVtLno_aem_JjFI9I25t05emk09ABFrqQ)

Six days of advanced exercises and improvisations to sharpen your skills and audience responsiveness, suitable for those who want to improve their technical skills and performance craft. This workshop gives you techniques to try out immediately in structured improvisation scenarios, so you can experience how they work.

Working together, the group acts like a diverse audience, providing support and feedback as you practice these techniques.

You can take the opportunity during the week to share and receive feedback on aspects of your own act in development. In addition, all participants will be part of an end-of-workshop showing developed from the collective workshop process.

Hey! I’m currently in Santa Barbara and looking for someone with a Sony FX3 who could help me shoot a few additional shots for my independent queer short film, “Chronique d’une obsession queer,” before November 7.

The shots would include close-ups of hands, gentle movements over the thighs, and separately recorded breathing. The tone is sensual but non-explicit, with no nudity. All framing and movements would be agreed upon with the performer beforehand.

It would be an unpaid collaboration. Would you be interested and available to film in Santa Barbara? Let me know what equipment you have!

POSZUKUJEMY AKTORÓW DO TELEDYSKU „RÓWNOLEGŁE WSZECHŚWIATY”| KUJAWSKO-POMORSKIE (TORUŃ)
9 Listopada

Młoda studentka medycyny i odnoszący sukcesy biznesmen stają 
przed wyborem, który może zadecydować o przyszłości ich związku, 
ale również o przedwczesnym końcu życia. W dwóch równoległych 
wszechświatach poznajemy konsekwencje każdej z decyzji.

POSZUKUJEMY OSÓB DO RÓL PIERWSZOPLANOWYCH:
• Studentka Medycyny

POSZUKUJEMY OSÓB DO RÓL DRUGOPLANOWYCH
• Student Medycyny
• Asystentka Biznesmana

WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY
• Formuła TFP
• Zwrot kosztów dojazdu
• Oznaczenie profili w materiałach promocyjnych
• Podanie profili w opisie teledysku na YouTube wraz z hiperłączami 

Projekt realizuje ekipa młodych pasjonatów. Zdjęcia odbędą się w Toruniu, z wykorzystaniem nietypowych lokacji i futurystycznej scenografii.
 
JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?
Napisz do nas w wiadomości prywatnej lub zostaw komentarz pod postem. W zgłoszeniu możesz krótko przedstawić siebie, podać wiek i przesłać zdjęcie lub link do swojego profilu.
Jeśli chcesz stać się częścią tej historii odezwij się koniecznie!
NEW LEVEL | „Równoległe Wszechświaty”

Actors are taught to work for the camera. But what changes when the camera is actually there?

In a self-tape, an audition or on set, the challenge is the same, making the performance feel real to the person watching.

At our FREE live Acting Masterclass, you’ll see actors demonstrate The Inspire Technique’s scripted and improv approaches in before and after performances. 

You’ll see what changes in the work, then get Michael Keogh’s breakdown of how the approach applies across performances.

Attend live and receive The Professional Actor’s Guide to Understanding the Film Lens, our FREE guide valued at $97.

Michael has had a 25-year acting career and is an award-winning director. His screen credits include Peaky Blinders, Casualty and Marvel’s Secret Invasion, to name a few.

Sunday 8 November · 6PM GMT / 1PM ET

RSVP AT THE FOLLOWING LINK:
https://bit.ly/4pCzU5V

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS
FINAL OPEN CASTING CALL

DIVA AIRWAYS: THE RISE & FALL

A Three-Act Comedy-Drama | World Premiere — Chicago, 2027

NON-UNION ACTORS ONLY | PAID ROLES

FlightTime Productions is seeking talented and dedicated performers for its upcoming world-premiere production of Diva Airways: The Rise & Fall, written and directed by Matthew Stevens.

Join us for this exciting original comedy-drama filled with laughter, friendship, family, workplace rivalries, and unexpected turbulence!

OPEN AUDITION INFORMATION

Monday, November 9, 2026

11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

West Loop Branch Library — Meeting Room

122 N. Aberdeen Street

Chicago, IL 60607

NO APPOINTMENT NECESSARY!

Audition check-in closes promptly at 4:00 PM.

AVAILABLE ROLES

All roles offer an $800 performance stipend.

* COLIN (16+) — Alexa’s caring younger brother, struggling with complicated family relationships.

* TIFFANY BELMONT (16+) — Miss Brooks’ stylish, ambitious, outspoken, and hilariously unpredictable assistant.

* BROOKLYN (16+) — The rival airline CEO’s daughter, whose loyalty begins to shift toward Diva Airways.

* SABRINA (25+) — A hardworking, loyal airline lounge manager confronting the company’s financial challenges.

AUDITION REQUIREMENTS

Please prepare a 1–2 minute comedic or dramatic monologue and bring a current headshot and acting résumé. Performers will also participate in group improvisation activities.

CALLBACKS — BY INVITATION ONLY

Friday, November 13, 2026 | 10:00 AM

Pullman Branch Library

11001 S. Indiana Avenue

Chicago, IL 60628

REHEARSALS & PERFORMANCES

Rehearsals Begin: January 10, 2027

Technical Rehearsals: April 4–7, 2027

Performance Engagement: April 8 – May 30, 2027

QUESTIONS & CASTING INQUIRIES

divaairwaysstage@gmail.com

Please note: West Loop Branch Library is not affiliated with or a sponsor of this production.

FLIGHTTIME PRODUCTIONS

Where the drama is first class, the comedy is nonstop, and the turbulence is guaranteed!

Wir suchen eine offene, selbstbewusste und charismatische Person, die für **Breathe Lio**, eine Marke, die Menschen beim Rauchstopp unterstützt, Straßeninterviews in Deutschland durchführt!

📍 **Standort:** Du solltest in einer deutschen Großstadt leben (Berlin, Hamburg, München, Köln, Frankfurt etc.).

💰 **Vergütung:** 50 € pro Stunde

⏰ **Dauer:** Ca. 3 Stunden pro Einsatz (150 € insgesamt)

📅 **Perspektive:** Mehrere Einsätze pro Monat möglich!

**Was du mitbringen solltest:**
* Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder fließendem Niveau
* Selbstbewusstes Auftreten und keine Scheu, fremde Menschen anzusprechen
* Offen, spontan und sympathisch vor der Kamera
* Erfahrung mit Straßeninterviews oder Content Creation ist ein Plus!

Wenn die ersten Interviews gut laufen, freuen wir uns auf eine **langfristige Zusammenarbeit** mit regelmäßigen Einsätzen!

**Interesse?** Schick uns eine kurze Vorstellung, deinen Wohnort und gerne Beispiele deiner bisherigen Arbeit.

🌐 [www.breathelio.com](http://www.breathelio.com/)

🎬 WIR VERSCHENKEN UNSERE SCHAUSPIEL- & CASTINGKURSE! 🤯✨

Diese Chance solltest du dir nicht entgehen lassen! 💙

Wir veranstalten unser letztes geplantes Live-Onlineseminar für Schauspieler und Darsteller:

🎬 CASTER BEGEISTERN
Lerne vor der Kamera zu strahlen und Zuschauer zu berühren.

📅 26. November 2026 | 18:00 Uhr

💻 Live & online

💙 Teilnahme für 0 €

UND WIR HABEN NOCH ETWAS BESONDERES FÜR EUCH! 🎁

Wir verschenken insgesamt 3 umfangreiche Kurspakete!

🏆 1 × CASTING KOMPLETT BUNDLE zuletzt verkauft für 997€

UND ZUSÄTZLICH:

🎁 2 × unser Schauspiel-Starterpaket!

Und wer die Kurse bereits hat, bekommt bei Gewinn ein exklusives Einzelcoaching mit Sarah 🔥
Damit haben gleich drei Menschen die Chance, mit unseren Kursen an ihrer Schauspielkarriere zu arbeiten!

SO BIST DU DABEI: 👇

1️⃣ Kommentiere: Warum möchtest ausgerechnet DU eines unserer Pakete gewinnen?

Zeig uns deine Persönlichkeit, deine Motivation und deine Begeisterung! 💙

2️⃣ Komm zum kostenlosen Onlineseminar „CASTER BEGEISTERN“. Den Anmeldelink erhältst du per Nachricht, sobald du kommentiert hast (Du kannst natürlich auch zum Seminar kommen ohne am Gewinnspiel teilzunehmen)

📣 Du kennst jemanden, für den das interessant sein könnte? Dann erzähl gerne von unserer Aktion! 

Umso engagierter du bist, umso eher gewinnst du! 

⏰ Teilnahmeschluss: 23.11.26 um 15 Uhr (MEZ)

Die drei Gewinner werden anhand ihrer Kommentare ausgewählt und im Live-Workshop am 26. November bekannt gegeben.

Wir freuen uns auf eure Geschichten und darauf, euch im Workshop zu sehen! 💙
